name: fsd50k-eval
split: eval split, 10,231 clips downloaded; 8,403 CC0 and CC BY clips usable
licence: CC0-1.0 / CC-BY-4.0 per clip (filtered); CC-BY-NC and Sampling+ clips excluded
licence_note: Per-clip: CC0, CC BY, CC BY-NC, CC Sampling+; dataset as a whole CC BY. Eval split: CC0 4,914 + CC BY 3,489 + CC BY-NC 1,425 + CC Sampling+ 403
attribution: FSD50K (Fonseca et al.), per-clip Freesound licences

licence_filter.rule: Only CC0 and CC BY clips may be used or committed; filter by the metadata before use.
licence_filter.unverified: The 200-class vocabulary was not read, so coverage of the wanted classes is unconfirmed.

notes: Best concrete option. Filter by the clip licence field in eval_clips_info_FSD50K.json (inside FSD50K.metadata.zip) to keep the 8,403 CC0 and CC BY clips (82%); the NC and Sampling+ clips are then dropped. Join the two zip parts with `zip -s 0 FSD50K.eval_audio.zip --out joined.zip` before unzipping. 6,258,901,239 B of audio (6,265,943,762 B with the three small files). UNVERIFIED: that the 200-class vocabulary (ground_truth zip) has every wanted class (doorbell, smoke alarm, baby crying, glass, kettle, phone, knock, dog, water, car horn, cafe, street, TV, music, cough, breathing); I could not read the vocabulary without downloading. Sound Events sets on Zenodo and Freesound CC0 packs were not found to be better and need an API key for per-clip licences (not researched further).
